font.reason: Neutral product-UI spec-sheet card; variable font keeps the original weight 500; its Latin glyphs cover the brand Raycast. Vazir Code (Persian monospace) looks stretched, and monospace was only needed for the original merge arithmetic, which is replaced by measurement.

comps.translatedSummary: جدید + rotating features (طراحی لانچر, حالت فشرده, ضبط میان‌بر, انواع میان‌بر, قابلیت‌های صوتی, طراحی تنظیمات, چت هوش مصنوعی, جستجوی فایل) then Raycast; converges to «جدید Raycast» with sub-line «به‌زودی ۲۰۲۶».

rtlDecisions.what: Pinned pair: NEW word and rotating feature word
rtlDecisions.why: جدید (reading start) pinned by right edge at x=1302, feature word pinned by left edge at x=618 and growing toward the centre; equal 618 px margins preserved.
Both words slide inward with the original 36f cubic ease-in-out to a centred phrase reading right-to-left (جدید Raycast).
Monospace step formula impossible with proportional Persian; phrase width is measured from the real font (delayRender until loaded), giving exactly one real space between the words.
Aligned to the phrase start (right) edge, as the original aligned to the left start.
Persian has no italic; distinction kept via dimmer colour #d8d8dc.
Removed, they break Persian joining; Latin Raycast is brand-cased.

rtlDecisions.what: Timing (STEPS dwell, START 8, delay 10, converge 36, sub delay 18, 4f fade), colours, hard cuts, zero shrink
rtlDecisions.why: Identity of the card (pinning then one reveal-converge).
Line-height raised to 1.5 and top offset compensated so the text row centre stays at y~519+.
2026 -> ۲۰۲۶ via faDigits; brand Raycast isolated with bdi.

rasterTextHandling: None: pure text on a flat background.
concerns: Registry duration is 16 frames while the design is ~180; verified with --duration 180 (original stills only exist up to f15, later beats checked against source logic). The 16-frame video only shows the first rotation step.
lessons: Proportional Persian font breaks monospace-based merge arithmetic: measure the phrase width in a hidden probe span after document.fonts.load, block the frame with delayRender, then position from the measured width.
Pinning an RTL pair: start-word by right edge, rotating word by left edge so it grows toward the centre, mirroring the Latin right-edge pin.
